dialogues.speaker: Loud Phantom
dialogues.text: Who're you? This is my seat, and everyone in the tavern knows it.

dialogues.speaker: Loud Phantom
dialogues.text: Did you only just report in on the island or something? You can't just turn up and take someone else's spot!

dialogues.speaker: Loud Phantom
dialogues.text: Also, where the devil's my beer? Hurry it up, would ya? I'm going out on patrol soon.

choices.text: This was indeed a tavern in the past.

response.speaker: Loud Phantom
response.text: If you must have it! But first, come and drink and sing with us. Once we're friends, sit anywhere you please!

response.speaker: Loud Phantom
response.text: You know the tune, right? Yo-ho, come on now! We'll sing one line, you'll sing the next!

response.speaker: Loud Phantom
response.text: "The sound of dancing drifted from my neighbors', it set my feet a-tapping, oh!"

response.speaker: Loud Phantom
response.text: The name's ███. Well, that makes us acquainted. The chair's all yours — I'm a generous fellow, after all!

response.speaker: Loud Phantom
response.text: You're a Ratnik too, eh? Don't worry, this drink's on me. Maybe we'll see each other again during training.

choices.text: Thank you — even though I can't drink it.

response.speaker: Loud Phantom
response.text: Well, I'm heading out on patrol. See you!
